title: Kylin Core Node Tools
description: Platform-reviewed native tools executed by the Kylin SafeOps Node Executor.

tools.title: Execute cleanup
tools.description: Archive and truncate approved demo directories with rollback metadata

reversibility.description: Restore files from the rollback package with kylin.cleanup.rollback.

tools.title: Plan cleanup
tools.description: Plan archive and truncate cleanup for approved demo directories

tools.title: Rollback cleanup
tools.description: Restore a cleanup rollback package from rollback_id

reversibility.description: Restores files from a rollback package; the restore itself is not compensated.

tools.title: Host triage summary
tools.description: Collect a read-only host triage summary

tools.title: Find large files
tools.description: Find large regular files under an allowed path root

tools.title: List open files
tools.description: List open files for an allowed path

tools.title: Read file SM3
tools.description: Read SM3 digest for an allowed file path

tools.title: Read file metadata
tools.description: Read metadata for an allowed file path

reversibility.description: Re-apply a block with kylin.firewall.block_ip if needed.

tools.title: Query journald
tools.description: Query journald logs for an allowlisted service

tools.title: Collect node_exporter snapshot
tools.description: Collect the configured node_exporter metrics snapshot

tools.title: Read KYSEC status
tools.description: Read KYSEC security status when available

tools.title: Read security-switch status
tools.description: Read Kylin security-switch status when available

tools.title: Disable service
tools.description: Disable an allowlisted service at boot

tools.title: Enable service
tools.description: Enable an allowlisted service at boot

reversibility.description: Reload applies the current unit configuration; there is no inverse command.
Restart is a stop then start; there is no single inverse besides another restart.

tools.title: Read service status
tools.description: Read the active, sub, load and unit-file state of one allowlisted systemd service.

tools.title: Workspace bash
tools.description: Execute a bash script inside the sandboxed workspace. The container has no network, no host access, and a read-only root filesystem.

reversibility.description: Script execution in the sandbox cannot be undone.

tools.title: Workspace edit
tools.description: Edit a file in the sandboxed workspace by replacing oldText with newText. Path must be relative and within the workspace.

reversibility.description: File edits in the sandbox are not automatically reversed.

tools.title: Workspace glob
tools.description: Glob for files in the sandboxed workspace filesystem. Pattern is relative to the workspace root.

tools.title: Workspace python
tools.description: Execute a python3 script inside the sandboxed workspace. The container has no network, no host access, and a read-only root filesystem.

reversibility.description: Script execution in the sandbox cannot be undone.

tools.title: Workspace read
tools.description: Read a file from the sandboxed workspace filesystem. Path must be relative and within the workspace.

tools.title: Workspace write
tools.description: Write a file in the sandboxed workspace filesystem. Path must be relative and within the workspace.

reversibility.description: Overwriting a workspace file does not keep the previous contents.
